captions: Tuesday, 1:10 p.m. Fourteenth floor. The concrete is still wet.
The crane swings. The foreman shouts. You keep going.
“I’ll pray tonight. All of it.” Like every day.
Then, from the minaret on the horizon: the adhan.
Down below, Yusuf takes off his gloves.
A piece of cardboard. Facing the qibla. Sujood.
Six minutes. Then he’s back on the scaffold.
The next day, 1:15. You take off your gloves too.
Cold water from the site tap. Cement on your wrists.
The building will fall one day. This sujood stays with Him.

post.caption:
14 floors built this year. Not one sujood for Allah. 🏗️

Tuesday, 1:10 p.m. Fourteenth floor. “I’ll pray tonight, all of it.” Then the adhan rises from a minaret on the horizon — and Yusuf, down below, takes off his gloves and prays on a piece of cardboard. Six minutes.

“Establish prayer for My remembrance.” (20:14)

Today at Dhuhr: gloves off. Six minutes for Him.
